dataset.name: original MIT human GSM8K test
dataset.disjoint_prior_ranks: G68-G77 original model rank sets 0–95 (G75 source-free consumed none)

reason: Independent unchanged real GPT2 c_proj dense output versus top-1536-neuron contribution-masked dense output diverges severely, even though contribution ranking uses full original activations and exact unchanged weight row norms. Cheap screen rejects future costly selective-neuron sparse engine for this fixed 50% policy.
limitations: Actual pretrained model and original heldout source; only FFN output projection, not whole-model masked token accuracy
Both masked and original projection use dense CPU kernels; no speedup measured
Importance needs full original neuron activations and weight norm precompute, so is not itself a cheaper selector
A different trained/adaptive sparse policy is a distinct proposal requiring separate preregistration, controls and heldout
No model promotion, scientific acceptance, RTX GPU track, native Wingless/Yggdrasil or FORGE controller change
